template.constraints: Use natural language similar to how a real employee would request a letter. Do not invent employee IDs or names — the bot shows them from its database.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user

variants.name: Employment letter happy flow
variants.goal: Request an employment letter and send it for HROPS approval

phases.description: Greet the bot and request an employment letter
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has displayed the employee details card and presented action options (Send for HROPS Approval, Go Home)

phases.description: Click or type 'Send For HROPS Approval'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has confirmed the employment letter request has been raised with HR team

variants.name: Employment letter HROPS approval flow
variants.goal: Approve a pending employment letter request as HROPS

phases.description: Greet the bot and state intent to approve employment letters
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has shown pending employment letter requests with Approve and Reject options

phases.description: Click or type 'Approve' on the pending request
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has confirmed the approval and sent the email trigger
phases.recoveryHint: If email trigger fails, note the error but accept it as partial pass

variants.name: Employment letter edge - go home without approval
variants.goal: Request an employment letter but choose Go Home instead of sending for approval

phases.description: Request employment letter and see the details card
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has shown the employee details card with action buttons

phases.description: Click or type 'Go Home' to cancel without approval
phases.completionCriteria: Bot returns to main menu or offers other services

variants.name: Employment letter edge - ambiguous intent
variants.goal: Test that the bot correctly interprets an ambiguous letter request

phases.description: Send an ambiguous or misspelled employment letter request
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has understood the intent and shown the employee details card OR asked a clarifying question
phases.recoveryHint: Try 'I need a letter from HR', 'employment certificate', 'letter for job', 'work letter'

phases.description: Confirm or clarify intent and reach the action options
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has presented action buttons (Send for HROPS Approval, Go Home)

variants.name: Employment letter edge - misspelled request
variants.goal: Verify the bot understands a misspelled or casual employment letter request

phases.description: Send request with typos like 'employmnt ltter' or 'emplyment lettr'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot understands and shows the employee details or asks clarifying question
phases.recoveryHint: Try various misspellings or synonyms: 'joining letter', 'salary letter', 'proof of employment'

phases.description: Complete the flow after intent is recognized
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows action buttons including Send for HROPS Approval

variants.name: Employment letter edge - repeat request
variants.goal: Test what happens when user requests employment letter twice in a row

phases.description: Request employment letter and see details card
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows employee details card with action buttons

phases.description: Request employment letter again without submitting the first one
phases.completionCriteria: Bot either shows the same card again, warns about duplicate, or handles gracefully

variants.name: Employment letter edge - random text before intent
variants.goal: Verify the bot handles small talk before getting to the employment letter request

phases.description: Say something unrelated first, then ask for employment letter
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows the employee details card after the user clarifies the intent
phases.recoveryHint: After any bot response to off-topic message, say 'I want an employment letter'

phases.description: Send for HROPS approval
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the employment letter request has been raised

variants.name: Employment letter - casual emp letter request
variants.goal: Request employment letter using casual phrasing like real chat ('i want emp letter')

phases.description: Say 'i want emp letter' or 'Hey I want emp letter'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows employee details card with Send for HROPS Approval OR explains issue fetching details without crashing
phases.recoveryHint: If bot shows main menu only, try 'employment letter' or click Employment/HR Letters then Employment Letter

phases.description: Send for HROPS approval if details card is shown
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms employment letter request raised with HR team
phases.recoveryHint: Skip if backend shows 'issue in fetching your details' — note as environment issue

variants.name: Employment letter - Hinglish mujhe emp letter chaiye
variants.goal: Request employment letter in Hinglish as employees do in chat

phases.description: Say 'mujhe emp letter chaiye'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot recognizes employment letter intent (details card, letter flow, or clear fetch error message)

phases.description: If employee card shown, send for HROPS approval
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms letter request raised OR still shows actionable next step

variants.name: Employment letter - after leave policy question
variants.goal: Ask leave policy then request employment letter in same session

phases.description: Ask 'tell me about leave policy'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot answers with leave policy information from knowledge base

phases.description: Then say 'i want employment letter'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot starts employment letter flow (details card or fetch-details message)

variants.name: Employment letter - fetch details error handling
variants.goal: When HR backend fails, bot shows 'issue in fetching your details' without breaking

phases.description: Request employment letter clearly
phases.completionCriteria: Bot responds with employee details card OR a clear 'issue in fetching your details' message (not empty/silent)
phases.recoveryHint: Try 'i want employment letter' after greeting
